description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API: any sklearn featurizer plus classifier can be wired in, with probability calibration applied automatically. The default baseline is a calibrated linear SVM.
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own low-confidence gate: any match clearing the plugin's low-confidence threshold fires, trading precision for recall versus the -medium fighter. Per-plugin config is identical to the -medium fighter.
